lessons: The failure was transient provider capacity ('Selected model is at capacity'), not a defect in the approach; rerun the same implementation at the same capability.
The aborted attempt had partly edited chupa/driver.py (run_seq) and added specs/triage.md. Start from a clean worktree, or re-read those files, before building on them.
Keep the per-message spool path <surface>/<run_seq>/<attempt>/ and the ValueError for run_seq with a non-None ticket. tests/test_driver.py must pass unedited.

Commit each record before resolving its message, and never put the raw message summary into a record body. Tests check both through a unique marker and through crash-resume over existing registry records.
Leave the drain path alone: no box read in the drain. Add only the one new test_drain.py test proving no triage request and no triage_pass journal entry during a dispatch+merge.
